title: 第22章 众生相第23章 帮派拳手
content_zh:
第二天的下午，陈冲在专属练功房中用功。
专属练功房是有暖气的，但陈冲打开了窗户，荒原上带着雪花的寒风便毫不客气的灌了进来。
陈冲一边练着搏击操，一边运转呼吸法。
在呼吸法的加持下，他的出拳几乎带起幻影，拳锋破空的凄厉呼啸甚至盖过了外面的风。
陈冲浑身散发着高热，鼻中更是喷出两条长蛇般的白气，在他身周环绕。
于峰教的这个方法很好用，可以直观的查看自己呼吸法的进度。
陈冲正琢磨着自己距离境界还有多远，或者说距离那几个还差临门一脚的正式拳手有多远，他听到门口响起了敲门声。
他收了功，走过去，拉开门一看，露出意外的神色。
“杨宇鹏？”
敲门的年轻男子神色局促，看着陈冲迟疑了片刻
“陈……冲？你壮了这么多！”
他惊讶的说道。
杨宇鹏也是之前龙虎豹的学员，是一起被骗到雷龙园区的同批。
不过他没分到拳馆这边，而是在另一边专职电诈。
陈冲自从来到这里后一直专心练拳，而且园区里管理也很严格，他还是第一次看到之前的同批学员。
此时见到杨宇鹏出现在这里，他也不明所以，只是让开了门
“快进来吧。”
杨宇鹏走了进来，悄然打量周围
“陈冲，这间练功房就你一个人啊？”
“嗯。”

“哇，厉害了。你果然成了正式拳手了！”
杨宇鹏看了一眼陈冲的身形，露出羡慕的神情。
其实陈冲并没有成为大块头，纵然他的气力比之前长了不知道多少，但主要是境界提升，骨壮生力。
只是相比之前的瘦弱，他体型变得匀称结实，个头拔高了好几公分，对这些一段时间没见的熟人来说，视觉上大了一大圈。
陈冲摇头
“运气好。你怎么想着过来了？”
杨宇鹏顿时露出黯然的神色
“我来是想问……李晓光真的，走了？”
陈冲一下想起来，杨宇鹏和李晓光似乎是校友，两人之前在拳馆的关系不错。
陈冲沉默一下，点了点头。
杨宇鹏的眼中一下失了光彩，愣了一会儿，才低声道
“这鬼地方……咱们这十来个人，不到一个月就少了两个了。”
“嗯？还有谁？”
陈冲意外道。
“就是何立军。他第一天腿不是被打断了吗？医务那边随便给他处理了下，结果很快感染了。这几天天气又冷得很，我们宿舍没暖气，他没能扛过去……人已经拉走了。”
陈冲想起了那个有些炸呼呼的年轻人，一时也不知道说什么。
“我还听说，这儿死的人都统一拉到镇上的医疗中心去‘处理’……”
content_en:
In the afternoon of the second day, Chen Chong practiced in the exclusive practice room.
The exclusive practice room was heated, but when Chen Chong opened the window, the cold wind carrying snowflakes from the wasteland poured in unceremoniously.
Chen Chong was practicing boxing exercises and breathing techniques at the same time.
With the blessing of the breathing method, his punches almost brought out phantoms, and the shrill roar of the punches piercing the air even overwhelmed the wind outside.
Chen Chong's whole body was exuding high fever, and two long snake-like white air spurted out from his nose, surrounding him.
This method taught by Yu Feng is very useful, and you can visually check the progress of your breathing method.
Chen Chong was just thinking about how far he was from the realm, or how far he was from the few official boxers who were still short of the finishing touch, when he heard a knock on the door.
He stopped his work, walked over, opened the door and took a look, showing an unexpected look.
"Yang Yupeng?"
The young man who knocked on the door looked embarrassed and hesitated for a moment as he looked at Chen Chong.
"Chen...Chong? You've grown so much!"
he said in surprise.
Yang Yupeng was also a former student of Longhubao, and was deceived into the same group as Leilong Park.
However, he was not assigned to the boxing gym, but worked full-time on the other side of the boxing gym.
Chen Chong has been focusing on practicing boxing since he came here, and the management in the park is also very strict. This is the first time he saw the same batch of students.
When he saw Yang Yupeng appearing here, he didn't know why, so he just let the door open.
"Come in quickly."
Yang Yupeng walked in and quietly looked around
"Chen Chong, are you the only one in this practice room?"
"Yeah."
"Wow, that's amazing. You have indeed become an official boxer!"
Yang Yupeng glanced at Chen Chong's figure and showed an envious expression.
In fact, Chen Chong has not become a big man. Even though his strength is much longer than before, the main reason is that his realm has improved and his bones have strengthened.
It's just that compared to the thin body before, his body has become well-proportioned and strong, and he is several centimeters taller. To these acquaintances who haven't seen him for a while, he looks a lot bigger visually.
Chen Chong shook his head
"Good luck. Why did you want to come here?"
Yang Yupeng suddenly showed a sad expression
"I came here to ask... is Li Xiaoguang really gone?"
Chen Chong suddenly remembered that Yang Yupeng and Li Xiaoguang seemed to be schoolmates, and they had a good relationship in the boxing gym.
Chen Chong was silent for a moment and nodded.
Yang Yupeng's eyes suddenly lost their luster, and he was stunned for a while before whispering:
"This damn place... there are about ten of us, but two are missing in less than a month."
"Huh? Who else?"
Chen Chong said unexpectedly.
"It's He Lijun. Wasn't his leg broken on the first day? The medical staff treated him casually, but he soon became infected. The weather has been very cold these days, and our dormitory has no heating, so he couldn't carry it... He has been taken away."
Chen Chong thought of the angry young man and didn't know what to say for a moment.
"I also heard that everyone who died here was taken to the town's medical center for 'processing'..."
